questions.stem: What is the product of a positive integer and a negative integer?
questions.solution: The product of a positive integer and a negative integer is always a negative integer because multiplying numbers with opposite signs results in a negative product. A positive integer multiplied by a negative integer cannot be positive or zero, as neither of those outcomes follows from the rules of sign multiplication. The product is always determined, so it cannot be classified as undetermined.

questions.stem: What is the product of two positive integers?
questions.solution: The product of two positive integers is always a positive integer because multiplying two numbers greater than zero results in a number greater than zero. Zero is incorrect because the product cannot be zero unless one of the numbers is zero, which is not the case here. A negative integer is incorrect because the product of two positive numbers is never negative. There is no uncertainty in this mathematical operation, so 'cannot be determined' is also incorrect.

hi.stem: दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का गुणनफल क्या होता है?
hi.solution: दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का गुणनफल हमेशा एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक होता है क्योंकि शून्य से बड़े दो संख्याओं को गुणा करने पर शून्य से बड़ी संख्या प्राप्त होती है। शून्य गलत है क्योंकि गुणनफल शून्य तभी हो सकता है जब कम से कम एक संख्या शून्य हो, जो यहां नहीं है। ऋणात्मक पूर्णांक गलत है क्योंकि दो धनात्मक संख्याओं का गुणनफल कभी भी ऋणात्मक नहीं होता। इस गणितीय संक्रिया में कोई अनिश्चितता नहीं है, इसलिए 'निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता' भी गलत है।

questions.stem: If the product of two integers is positive, which of the following must be true?
choices: One integer is positive and one is negative
questions.solution: If the product of two integers is positive, both integers must be non-zero because zero multiplied by any number is zero, not positive. Both integers could be positive or both could be negative, but they cannot include zero. Options A and B are possible but not guaranteed, and option C is incorrect because a positive product cannot result from one positive and one negative integer.

questions.stem: If a and b are integers such that a × b is positive, which of the following must be true?
